messages:
Hana (People Ops): Quick sync: creating a standard gift-card payout workflow for spot awards. Objective: reduce manual vendor emails and ensure tax/compliance checks. Need payroll + finance sign-off by Thu.
Liam (Payroll): Key constraints: vendor cards require vendor_id and 72h lead time. Payroll inclusion needs a manager_approver_email and falls on Wed cutoff for same-week pay.
Pri (Finance): Also need GL mapping per team and a budget_code field. Can we default by org with override?
Hana (People Ops): Yes — default budget_code populated from org, with manager override and finance approval step in Airtable.
Ria (Eng): For international folks, can we send local e-gift cards instead of USD cards? Some countries block foreign cards.
Liam (Payroll): We should capture recipient_country and preferred_payout_method (local_gift / prepaid_usd / payroll). Payroll will pick best route; ops to collect country in form.
Hana (People Ops): Draft form fields: nominator, nominee_name, nominee_email, org, team, award_amount, budget_code, recipient_country, payout_method, manager_approver_email, public_shoutout (yes/no), internal_note.
Pri (Finance): Add cumulative_awards_90d field (ops calculates) and tax_flag auto-set if >$600. Finance will review overrides.
Ria (Eng): UX ask: show a tooltip on award caps per recipient to avoid accidental aggregation over $600.
Hana (People Ops): Good call. We'll add cap warning and block submit if it pushes recipient over $1,000 in 90 days without escalation.
sam-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Gift-card payout workflow review" Thu 9am PT.
Liam (Payroll): For pilot, I'll test vendor flow with TEST-VEND-009. Provide a test recipient and I'll confirm delivery timing.
Hana (People Ops): Test recipient: Test User test.user+gc@redwood.ai. We'll run pilot with Eng, Sales, and Ops (10 awards) next week.
Pri (Finance): I'll provide GL list and confirm budget_code defaults by EOD Wed.
Hana (People Ops): Thanks team. After sign-off we'll publish manager playbook: approval SLA = 48h, payout goal = 5 business days, opt-out respected for public shoutouts. Post the Airtable link here when ready.
Ria (Eng): One more: include a manager sample message template for the recipient and the #wins shoutout. Makes adoption easier.
Hana (People Ops): Will add templates. Ping me for edits. Thanks!
